==============================================================================
 Risk of Rain (2013) - OnionOS Port Instructions (Miyoo Mini / Mini Plus)
==============================================================================

To play Risk of Rain on your Miyoo Mini / Miyoo Mini Plus:

1. Obtain your legally purchased copy of Risk of Rain (2013) on PC (Steam).

2. Copy your game files from PC into this folder on your SD card:
   `/mnt/SDCARD/Roms/PORTS/Games/Risk of Rain/`

   You can simply copy:
   - `data.win` (OR `Risk of Rain.exe` — the on-device optimizer will auto-extract it!)
   - All `.ogg` music files (e.g., `musicStage1.ogg`, `musicBoss1a.ogg`, etc.)

3. FIRST BOOT (AUTONOMOUS SETUP):
   When you launch "Risk of Rain" on your console for the first time:
   - An on-screen progress bar (`setup_miyoo`) will automatically appear.
   - It extracts `data.win` if needed, normalizes Linux audio filename casing,
     and creates optimal handheld defaults (Graphics: Low, Gamepad: Enabled).
   - Once complete (100%), the game launches immediately!

4. (Optional - Advanced Offline Texture Quantization):
   If you want 16-bit RGB565 compressed textures for lowest RAM usage (<28 MB),
   you can also run the offline Python optimizer on PC:
     python tools/optimize_ror_assets.py --input <path_to_game>
   which produces `data_mmp.win`. If present, it is automatically prioritized.

Enjoy Risk of Rain on OnionOS!
